description: This PHP source file provides utility classes and functions for installation, migration, configuration management, and module handling in the vtiger CRM project. It includes classes like Installation_Utils, Migration_Utils, ConfigFile_Utils, and Common_Install_Wizard_Utils that facilitate database connections, module installation, language file copying, configuration file creation, and more.

classes.name: Installation_Utils
classes.description: Provides utility functions for installation, including database connection checks, installing modules, and copying required files.

classes.name: Migration_Utils
classes.description: Contains functions for verifying migration info, copying files, and handling optional and custom module deployment.

classes.name: ConfigFile_Utils
classes.description: Manages the creation and content of configuration files based on provided parameters.

classes.name: Common_Install_Wizard_Utils
classes.description: Offers system-wide utilities related to install process, module management, and system checks.

methods.name: Migration_Utils::verifyMigrationInfo
methods.description: Verifies the provided migration info and database connection parameters, ensuring readiness for migration.

methods.name: Migration_Utils::getFilesFromFolder
methods.description: Recursively copies files from source to destination folders, optionally force copying specified files.

methods.name: ConfigFile_Utils->createConfigFile
methods.description: Generates a configuration file ('config.inc.php') based on class parameters.

methods.name: Common_Install_Wizard_Utils::installMandatoryModules
methods.description: Installs all modules marked as mandatory from the system packages.

methods.name: Common_Install_Wizard_Utils::getMandatoryModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of all mandatory module names.

methods.name: Common_Install_Wizard_Utils::installSelectedOptionalModules
methods.description: Installs user-selected optional modules and language packs.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes a database query and logs success or failure, outputting HTML formatted status.

methods.name: executePQuery
methods.description: Prepares and executes a parameterized database query, logging success or failure with formatted output.
